pr_title: Add browser-like tab management hotkeys to chat overlay
pr_body:
Fixes #10148

- [x] Depends on #13314.

Adding in web browser-like keyboard shortcuts to the chat overlay:
- Closing a single chat tab with Ctrl + w 
- Pulling up the channel selector overlay with Ctrl + t to open a new tab
- Reopening the most recently closed tab that has not already been reopened Ctrl+Shift+t

Co-Authors: @jessmeng @Joseph-Ramos-CMU
pr_comments: On reading this diff again I noticed that the <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd> hotkey is not tested. It would be nice to have coverage for this as well.

I believed we've addressed all the critical changes you requested. As for test coverage for Ctrl+Shift+t, we tried adding tests but were having a lot of issues with Appveyor. The commit history should show some of the tests we tried. Pretty much followed the same format as the Ctrl+W and Ctrl+T tests, but it wasn't working for some reason. It might be because the Ctrl+Shift+t shortcut only works if the user has the chat tabs selected, but even after updating the tests to account for this we still had issues.

Let us know if there are any other must-do fixes.
There's still some weirdness left in this PR that I hadn't seen or had time to address properly yet. Going to try and clean this up more myself now.

Have pushed my changes, mostly cosmetic. I did spot one more issue, namely that when the channel selector overlay is open, the hotkeys stop working - I think it's because the channel selector is taking  focus away from the chat overlay, so I'm not sure that's easily fixable. Other than that seems passable.

@peppy feel free take a look at the latest changes if you're so inclined :)

issue_context.title: make some browser tab shortcuts work for osu chat tabs
issue_context.body:
**Describe the new feature:** 
make ctrl+w, ctrl+shift+t, ctrl+t do the same thing you would expect them to do in your browser
**Proposal designs of the feature:** 
ctrl+w - close the active chat tab if chat is opened (already works in stable i believe)
ctrl+shift+t - reopen closed chat tabs in the order in which they were closed
ctrl+t - I imagine maybe prompting a user to enter a name while user search results are showing up so they can choose if they're unsure with the name

review_comments: We actually have an existing utility collection that does this in this repository (see `LimitedCapacityStack`). It would have to be moved out from its current namespace first, though, so unsure if worth - and even then maybe best left for a separate pull.
